brief: A soldering station for my bench: a holder for the iron while it is switched on and hot, plus two bins for solder and spare tips.

requirements.evidence: Two hex-acc-saddle-half cradles (accessory:0#1,0#0, accessory:0#1,0#1) on cell 1,0,0 cover form a two-point rest for the iron barrel/handle. No dedicated iron-holder part exists in catalog; saddles provide the shape. Heat safety unmet: configurator checks fit only, parts are user-chosen 3D print with no rated heat resistance.
requirements.requirement: Holder for the iron while switched on and hot

requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full holds solder-reel prop; bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div3 with 3 compartments for small parts
requirements.requirement: Two bins for solder and spare tips

requirements.evidence: solder-reel prop in full bin; tweezers + heap-standoffs-div3 props in div3 bin as tip/small-part proxies - no dedicated spare-tip prop in catalog
requirements.requirement: Staged to show solder and spare tips use

finish.summary: 3-cell station: two saddle cradles as iron rest on covered cell, full bin with solder reel, 3-compartment bin with tweezers/small parts. Mesh clear, capped and locked. Hot-use heat rating unmet - plastic print not rated for hot iron contact.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.name: Port plug
parts.use: Blanks a side port you are not using, so a cell that is closed up looks finished and nothing gets in through a hole you left open.

parts.name: Port louvre
parts.use: Vents a closed cell without letting rain in, so a box that has to breathe can still stand outside.

parts.name: Port screen
parts.use: Passes air and keeps insects and debris out, so a cell can breathe through an opening that is still covered.

parts.name: Port hose barb
parts.use: Lands a hose on a cell, so water arrives and leaves through a spigot drawn for it rather than over an edge.

parts.name: Port cable plate
parts.use: Leads cable through a side port on finished holes, so wiring enters a closed cell through something drawn for it and each run has its own way in.
